name: Laundry POS Expense Invoice Entry - Auto Login

parameters.content:
## POS Expense / Purchase Invoice Entry
Webhook receives expense invoice JSON, logs into POS automatically, creates header, adds expense lines, then approves the expense.

Required n8n Variables: POS_USERNAME, POS_PASSWORD, AIPSOFT_API_USER_ID. Optional: AIPSOFT_CLIENT_IDENTIFIER=inout, AIPSOFT_DEFAULT_BRANCH_ID=1, AIPSOFT_DEFAULT_PAY_ACCOUNT_ID.

parameters.jsCode:
const today = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Dubai', year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' }).format(new Date());
return [{ json: { branch_id: '1', pay_account: 'REPLACE_PAY_ACCOUNT_ID', date: today, bill_date: today, bill_no: 'TEST-' + Date.now(), remark: 'n8n test expense invoice', vendor_id: '', driver_id: '', project_id: '', account_segment_id: '', account_class_id: '', lines: [{ account_head: '33958', notes: 'Test miscellaneous expense from n8n', amount: 1, tax_amount: 0, total: 1 }] } }];
